title: Italian Tomato Basil Garlic Toast
summary: Crisp olive-oil garlic toast topped with juicy chopped tomato and fresh basil. It is a simple vegan Italian-style snack, best when tomatoes are ripe and the toast is served while still warm.

ingredients.name: garlic cloves, 1 for rubbing and 1 finely grated

steps: Put the diced tomatoes in a bowl with the grated garlic, 1 tablespoon of olive oil, salt and black pepper. Stir gently and leave to sit for 5 minutes so the tomatoes become juicy.
Toast the bread until crisp and golden at the edges, either in a toaster or under a hot grill for 2–3 minutes per side.
While the toast is still hot, rub one side of each slice with the remaining whole garlic clove so the surface picks up the garlic aroma.
Drizzle the rubbed toast with the remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil.
Fold the torn basil through the tomato mixture, then spoon it generously over the garlic toast. Serve immediately while the bread is crisp.
